title: Prove landed CI wall-time history through typed backend handlers

intentCoverage.report:
Verdict: Caught (on the non-web run URL path, by the maintained test-support helper's schema parse, before the case's own explicit runUrl assertions ran).

Story and revision: .planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#renovate-landed-ci-backend-proof, plan .planning/slice-plans/805-renovate-landed-ci-backend-proof/PLAN.md slice 4; revision d3dd9415df2569fcdb0d8707ed204b2eea9b4ff6 (claude/prove-landed-ci-wall-time-history-through-typed), checked out in an isolated detached scratch worktree with npm ci. Pre-probe scratch state: clean.

Promise checked: a run link that is not a web address is left out of both a measured point and a pending gap. (The backwards-duration rule was not faulted; one fault only.)

Fault: dashboard/server/landedCiHistoryEntries.ts, runOf() line 46. Changed
  ...(runUrlSchema.safeParse(runUrl).success ? { runUrl } : {}),
to
  ...(runUrl === undefined ? {} : { runUrl }),
runOf is the single projection used by both points and pending gaps (and by historyBuildOf for final gaps). Fixtures and assertions untouched. (A first attempt at the edit was a syntax error that failed the transform; it was discarded as not evidence and redone.)

Maintained check examined: dashboard/backend-tests/intent/landed-ci-history-gaps.spec.ts, case at line 133 "a build that completed before it started ... and a run link that is not a web address is left out of a point and a pending gap" (fixtures: run 65 measured with url "javascript:alert(65)", run 66 in_progress with url "javascript:alert(66)").

Run observations (focused command: caffeinate -s -i env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_BACKEND_PROOF_RECORD=<tmp> npm run --silent test:dashboard:backend -- landed-ci-history-gaps.spec.ts --workers=2):
- Baseline: 2/2 passed; target case ran (line 133, 10 ms).
- Independent wrong-behavior witness: esbuild-bundled the faulted module into job tmp and called runOf({runUrl:"javascript:alert(65)",runId:65,runAttempt:1}) -> {"runUrl":"javascript:alert(65)","runId":65,"runAttempt":1}, i.e. the non-web link is kept.
- Faulted run: target case failed, other case passed. The catch is in the helper historyEntries (dashboard/backend-tests/support/landedCiPassInputs.ts:124, landedCiHistorySchema.parse(read.answer)), called from the spec at line 163: ZodError invalid_format url at entries[2].runUrl (the measured point) and entries[3].runUrl (the pending gap). So the production history read (performIntentCiHistoryRead) answered with both non-web links, and the public history schema in the test helper rejected them. The case's explicit expect(entries[2]/[3]).not.toHaveProperty("runUrl") assertions were not reached; they would be the backstop if the helper ever stopped parsing through the schema.
- Restoration: original file restored by exit trap; git diff empty, no untracked changes outside ignored test-results; same command rerun: 2/2 passed. Scratch worktree removed with git worktree remove --force; the execution worktree was not edited (clean, HEAD unchanged).

Next proof action: none required for this promise on the observed path. Optional: none new; the explicit not.toHaveProperty assertions already exist as a second layer.
Prior disposition: execution recorded no scratch mutation for this rule; this probe supplies that evidence. It is not a new repair decision. The backwards-duration ("not-recorded" gap, not zero point) rule remains unprobed.

Costs:
- Test runtime (measured, Vitest-reported Duration): baseline 964 ms, faulted 522 ms, restored 351 ms (plus one discarded transform-failure run of 270 ms); about 2.1 s total.
- Human effort: unavailable; no human took part in this probe.
- Agent effort: unavailable; no separately supported token or tool-time measure was available to this agent.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 77557 ms (measured), from 1795510815564 to 1795510893121 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision d3dd9415df2569fcdb0d8707ed204b2eea9b4ff6, verdict Caught, no follow-up.
